description: Stabilize the Playwright E2E baseline by fixing mock/data-seeding drift so the full suite runs green and becomes a trustworthy quality gate.

sprint.goal: Make the existing Playwright E2E suite deterministic and green, and wire it into the quality workflow so regressions are caught before merge.

stories.title: Audit baseline failures and classify root causes
Build deterministic E2E seed and fixture factory
Wire E2E baseline into CI and closeout
